title: What Does the Bible Say About Ghosts? 25 Verses
description: Does the Bible say ghosts are real? Verses on the dead, the witch of Endor, Jesus walking on water and what Scripture says happens after death.
keywords: what does the bible say about ghosts
are ghosts real according to the bible
bible verses about ghosts and spirits
summary: In the World English Bible the word ghost appears in only 2 verses outside the Holy Ghost, Matthew 14:26 and Mark 6:49, where the disciples cry out in fear because they think Jesus walking on the sea is a ghost. The King James Version uses 'give up the ghost' for dying in 19 verses (for example Genesis 25:8 and Luke 23:46), which is where much of the English word's biblical use comes from. The Bible forbids consulting the dead (Deuteronomy 18:10-12, Leviticus 19:31), records one appearance of Samuel to Saul at Endor (1 Samuel 28), and teaches that after death comes judgment, not wandering (Hebrews 9:27). The verses below cover the passages people cite when they ask about ghosts.

faqs.q: Does the Bible say ghosts exist?
faqs.a: It never describes ghosts as wandering spirits of the dead. It does record the dead appearing on rare occasions (Samuel in 1 Samuel 28, Moses and Elijah in Matthew 17:3), and it warns against contacting the dead (Deuteronomy 18:10-12). Hebrews 9:27 says people die once and then face judgment.

faqs.q: What was the witch of Endor story?
faqs.a: King Saul asked a medium to call up the prophet Samuel, and Samuel appeared and told Saul he would lose the battle (1 Samuel 28:11-19). Saul had banned mediums himself (1 Samuel 28:3). Readers disagree on whether it was truly Samuel, but the text calls the figure Samuel and treats the consultation as part of Saul's rebellion (1 Chronicles 10:13-14).

faqs.q: Did the disciples think Jesus was a ghost?
faqs.a: Yes, twice. They saw him walking on the water and cried out (Matthew 14:26, Mark 6:49), and after the resurrection they were terrified and thought they saw a spirit until he showed his hands and feet and ate fish (Luke 24:36-43).

faqs.q: What happens when a person dies according to the Bible?
faqs.a: Believers are described as being 'at home with the Lord' (2 Corinthians 5:8) and with Christ (Philippians 1:23); the dead await resurrection and judgment (Hebrews 9:27, John 5:28-29). No verse has the dead returning to haunt the living.
